jobs.title: Team Lead, SEO & GEO (all genders)
jobs.description:
The role

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by making it easier for customers around the world to discover, plan, and enjoy high-quality meals. Over the past decade, we’ve grown from a meal-kit company into a global food solutions group, active across multiple brands including HelloFresh, Factor, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chef’s Plate, and Youfoodz.

As search behavior evolves across Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Reddit, and other discovery surfaces, our SEO team is expanding its focus from traditional organic search to broader Organic Discovery: building the content, technical, authority, and measurement foundations that help customers find our brands wherever discovery and dinner decisions happen.

We are looking for a Team Lead, SEO & GEO to lead our global Organic Discovery team and help shape the next phase of how HelloFresh Group approaches organic growth. This role will lead a team of SEO/GEO specialists and work across international markets to translate global strategy into scalable programs that grow non-brand organic demand, strengthen our visibility across traditional and AI-driven search, and improve the quality and discoverability of our content.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Content, Brand, and local Marketing teams to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact work, and build scalable solutions across brands and markets. You’ll need to be equally comfortable setting strategy, coaching a team, digging into performance data, and influencing senior stakeholders to move complex initiatives forward.

 

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of SEO/GEO specialists, setting clear priorities and creating an environment of strong ownership, collaboration, and continuous development.
  • Help define and execute the global SEO & GEO strategy across HelloFresh Group brands and markets, translating broader Organic Discovery priorities into actionable roadmaps.
  • Identify opportunities to grow non-brand organic demand and customer acquisition across traditional search engines, AI search experiences, and emerging discovery platforms.
  • Partner with local Marketing teams to understand market-specific opportunities and challenges while building global strategies, standards, and solutions that can scale across markets.
  • Lead cross-functional Organic Discovery initiatives spanning technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimization, structured data, internal linking, authority and trust signals, and GEO/AI visibility.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate SEO/GEO opportunities into clear requirements, influence roadmap prioritization, and ensure Organic Discovery is considered in all major product and platform decisions.
  • Develop scalable approaches to content creation, optimization, and governance across recipe, editorial, transactional, and other high-value organic surfaces.
  • Advance our GEO strategy by identifying how our brands can become more visible, cited, and authoritative across AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Use search, analytics, AI visibility, competitive, and internal business data to identify opportunities, diagnose performance changes, prioritize investments, and measure impact.
  • Establish clear performance reporting and communicate SEO/GEO performance, opportunities, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Support global and local teams with SEO/GEO expertise, creating frameworks and best practices that enable markets to move quickly without sacrificing quality or consistency.
  • Manage relationships with relevant agencies, technology partners, and vendors where appropriate, ensuring external resources are aligned to our strategy and delivering measurable value.
  • Stay ahead of changes in search behavior, search engine platforms, generative AI, and the broader discovery ecosystem, translating emerging trends into practical implications for HelloFresh Group.

 

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of experience in SEO / Organic Growth, ideally within large-scale, international, consumer-facing websites.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing SEO or Organic Growth teams, with the ability to balance people leadership with hands-on strategic involvement.
  • Broad SEO expertise spanning technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimization, authority, international SEO, and performance measurement.
  • Strong understanding of how AI-powered search and answer engines are changing organic discovery, with curiosity and practical experience applying GEO/AEO principles.
  • Experience developing strategies and roadmaps across multiple markets, brands, or business units and balancing global scalability with local-market needs.
  • Strong ability to partner with Product and Engineering teams, translate organic growth opportunities into clear requirements, and influence prioritization without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using platforms such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Profound, Screaming Frog, or similar SEO, analytics, and AI-visibility tools.
  • Ability to connect SEO/GEO performance to broader business outcomes and clearly communicate priorities, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience navigating complex, cross-functional organizations.
  • High ownership, strong judgment, and comfort operating in an evolving environment where priorities, technologies, and customer discovery behaviors are changing quickly.

 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meal

jobs.title: Director, Paid Search (all genders)- maternity leave cover
jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

As the Director, Paid Search (maternity leave cover), you will be responsible for moving HelloFresh Group's paid search stack into the next autonomous era. You will lead our largest multi-MM$ performance digital channel across our global portfolio, with strategic focus on three platforms: Google, Bing, and OpenAI. You will lead a team of Search experts and architect a future-proof search infrastructure whilst scaling cost-effective customer acquisition campaigns across these channels. Reporting to the Senior Director, Performance Marketing, you will develop and execute strategic plans, use analytics to inform decisions, and drive execution to optimize marketing budgets against company profitability goals. 

This is a high-impact role with the opportunity to work with teams across the organisation, from Pricing & Discounts, MarTech and Analytics. From the start, we would like you to focus on transforming our search stack to be competitive for years to come, identifying and driving strategic investments across Google, Bing, and OpenAI, working with our in-house experts and dedicated technical/account management teams to formulate Joint Business/technical Plans and build the infrastructure that will drive HelloFresh's paid search future. 

What you’ll do: The Recipe

  • Lead the global paid search team and develop them into a true 'centre of excellence' for Search internationally, including expertise in next-generation platform capabilities 
  • Transform and architect the search stack: Design and build a modern, scalable, future-proof paid search infrastructure across Google, Bing, and OpenAI that positions HelloFresh for sustained competitive advantage 
  • Conduct comprehensive audits to bring our Search account setup to industry 'best in class' standards across all three platforms, identifying gaps and modernisation opportunities 
  • Own the paid search strategy strategy, set and drive the strategic direction across search channels, supporting the move into the next autonomous era 
  • Manage global budget allocation: Set and dynamically reallocate budget across markets, brands, and channels to hit volume growth and CPA/CAC targets, forecasting and reporting with rigour.
  • Lead senior agency and platform relationships: Act as the strategic lead and escalation point for external agencies and platform partners (including Google, DSPs, and mobile platforms), setting the agenda on plans, investment, and innovation.
  • Work closely with Marketing Analytics to execute tests across search portfolios to measure incrementality and marginal efficiency and consequently optimise in-house systems and algorithms to profitably scale our Search marketing programmes 
  • Act as a close partner to MarTech teams to bring the search staack into the next stage of automation 

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 

  • A Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record and/or proven relevant experience in a performance marketing or highly commercial role within D2C or subscription-based businesses 
  • 8+ years experience in Google Advertising ecosystem, either from an agency or client-side role
  • Forward-thinking about how platform evolution and automation are reshaping paid search strategy, you understand both traditional optimisation and next-gen platform capabilities, and you see transformation as both challenge and opportunity 
  • Early experience or exposure to OpenAI's Search offering or emerging AI-driven search platforms 
  • 5+ years experience in team management and leadership roles 
  • Proven experience building and embedding incrementality-based measurement frameworks (e.g. geo-testing, regression, multi-touch attribution) and partnering with Analytics on marketing mix modelling (MMM) and advanced measurement.
  • Expert knowledge of Google bidding, targeting, and optimisation 
  • Experience managing campaigns in all Google campaign types: Keyword Search, PMAX, Shopping, etc. 
  • Experience working with performance marketing metrics and platform reporting 
  • Experience working with Media-Mix-Models, Multi-Touch/Data-Driven Attributions, or other advanced marketing measurement methodologies 
  • Strong organisational skills and project management ability 
  • Industry certifications on Google and Bing Ads
  • An entrepreneurial mindset: you embrace ownership, make bold, data-driven decisions, and relentlessly pursue innovative solutions to drive sustainable growth. Comfortable navigating ambiguity, testing new approaches, and learning from both successes and failures.

What we offer: The Toppings 

  • Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
  • Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
  • Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
  • Thrive in a high-performance environment: Work with ambitious, intellectually curious peers on a global scale, enjoying an environment built for empowerment and speed.
  • Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
  • Save with discount schemes and corporate benefits via Vorteile.net
  • Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.
  • Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.
  • Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world's leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is at our core and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. KAYAK is looking for a Data Engineer to build the trusted data foundation behind machine learning across the company. You’ll partner with data scientists to understand their modeling needs and what the available data can (and can’t) support. You’ll transform large-scale raw data into production-ready datasets and build the scalable pipelines that make them dependable and reusable. Working across Data Science, Data Engineering, and Data Platform, you’ll help address data gaps and bring new machine-learning use cases into production. If you’re excited to shape how teams across KAYAK use data to build and scale machine learning, we’d love to hear from you. This role will be required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week. In this role, you will: Partner with the Data Science teams and help translate modeling needs into dataset requirements, then collaborate with Data Engineering and Data Platform to extend foundational pipelines into ML-ready datasets. Design scalable and efficient dataset workflows and ensure pipeline reliability through validation, monitoring, and alerting; diagnose and resolve issues. Ship production-ready data solutions that enable ML applications and deliver real-world impact on user experience and key business metrics. Identify gaps and opportunities, contributing to technical decisions and roadmap priorities that strengthen the data foundation for current and future ML use cases. Collaborate across Data Science, Engineering, and Data Platform, communicating technical decisions, findings, and trade-offs clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences. Please apply if you have: Strong technical foundations in data engineering, software engineering, and systems design, backed by a track record of building and operating reliable, large-scale data pipelines. Demonstrated capability matters more than academic credentials. Hands-on experience developing production data pipelines, with the ability to clearly explain the problems addressed, your specific contributions, and the resulting impact. Ownership, sound judgment, and systems thinking, with the ability to navigate technical, reliability, cost, and risk trade-offs while working independently and recognizing when to seek guidance. Fluency with AI-assisted workflows, leveraging modern tools to improve productivity and quality while critically evaluating their outputs and limitations. Curiosity, humility, and a collaborative mindset, with a commitment to continuous learning, sharing knowledge, and improving together. You will be tasked with supporting and developing the Financial modules of our ERP system - Oracle Financials Cloud as well as supporting the team with other systems within Finance.   • Troubleshoot, support, and constantly look for ways to enhance our financial systems and processes
  • Support implementation, migration, and integration of the already existing Oracle modules

  • Participate in quarterly upgrade testing and validation efforts
  • Communicate effectively with internal teams and external partners
  • Prepare and deliver reports, recommendations, or alternatives that help address business needs from the ERP system
  • Ensure best practices are followed within the ERP system

    administration tasks and resolve issues
  • Create and maintain accurate and up-to-date process documentation (e.g. Standard Operating Procedures, design documents, migration forms)

What you’ll bring

A hugely assertive, inquisitive self-starter with a problem-solving, logical mindset to approach demanding challenges who shares our passion for continuous improvement and growth.

  • Demonstrated experience in supporting and implementing financial systems
  • Minimum 2-3 years of relevant administration experience with either Oracle (Fusion Cloud or EBS) or other cloud-based ERP solutions
  • Ability to translate business requirements into system configurations and setups
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and using Oracle APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with BI Publisher and OTBI.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), organizational and planning skills
  • Ability to work in a team environment and interact well with employees at all organizational levels
  • A Bachelor’s degree in IT, Finance, Accounting, or a related field of study. Individuals with leadership, project management, analytical, and excellent communication skills (oral and written) are required.

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • This position is a one-year fixed-term contract to cover a maternity leave.
  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

jobs.title: Commercial Operations Specialist
jobs.description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. KAYAK's Search Data & Quality team works to ensure that the travel results seen by millions of users every day are accurate, complete, and trustworthy. As a Commercial Operations Specialist , you will take ownership of a dedicated area of accuracy operations - operating monitoring processes, investigating issues, identifying root causes, and working with colleagues across Engineering, Performance Marketing, and Commercial to make sure problems are resolved and processes are well-documented for the long term. This role will be required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week. In this role, you will: Maintain and operate recurring monitoring processes to track accuracy across hotel search results, identifying issues proactively before they affect users or partners Investigate accuracy issues - such as price discrepancies, availability mismatches, and linking errors - categorise root causes, and coordinate with internal teams to drive resolution Define and document clear escalation paths, ensuring the right teams are engaged at the right time and that recurring issues are tracked through to a fix Build and maintain documentation so that coverage and backup are always in place Monitor key performance indicators to identify risks and opportunities, and propose practical solutions Coordinate with Engineering, Performance Marketing, and Commercial colleagues; translate findings into clear, actionable requests Contribute to broader data quality initiatives as the scope of the role evolves over time Share knowledge with teammates and support the team's learning on accuracy operations, tools, and processes Please apply if you have: 1-3 years of experience working in operations, analytics, or a related role, with demonstrated impact on product or business outcomes; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills are equally considered A methodical, investigative approach to problem-solving - comfortable digging into data to find root causes and propose solutions Comfort working with data - for example, using SQL or a comparable tool - and the ability to turn findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical colleagues Experience contributing to multiple projects simultaneously and making informed decisions about priorities Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to prepare concise documentation and present findings to colleagues and leadership A collaborative approach and enjoyment of building working relationships across engineering, commercial, and marketing teams Attention to detail and a genuine care for data accuracy and quality A proactive approach to problem-solving and a willingness to take ownership of your work It would be a bonus if you also have: Familiarity with the travel industry, online travel agencies, or hotel distribution Experience with data visualization tools or log analysis platforms (these can also be developed on the job) Curiosity about how large-scale search systems work and how data accuracy affects user experience. Benefits and Perks: Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year Focus on mental health and well-being: Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!) No meeting Fridays Paid parental leave Paid volunteer time Focus on your career growth: Development Dollars Leadership development Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings Travel Discounts Employee Resource Groups 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday Free lunch 2 days per week Pension plan contributions Public transportation subsidies Bike leasing program Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin Inclusion At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here. jobs.description:
Data Analyst - Investments

Summary

We are seeking an organised and self-motivated Data Analyst to work embedded in our Investments team, to help shape the development of one of the world's leading FinTech products. 

About the opportunity

As a Data Analyst, you will enable our product and business segments in the Financial Empowerment domain, specifically Investments, to make data-driven decisions. You will monitor, measure and analyse the effectiveness of your product teams' initiatives, helping to drive the strategy of your business segment. You will apply robust analytical approaches, including experimentation and causal inference methods where appropriate, to understand the impact of product and business decisions on customer and business outcomes. You are here to establish a data mindset and thereby foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. You will work in a cross-functional setup, collaborating closely with other analysts, engineers, designers, and product managers.

In this role, you will:

  • Help us set the right goals: Develop clear and measurable targets based on an initiatives’ scope. Improve our overall forecasting and goal setting capabilities. 

  • Handle stakeholders: Be an internal go-to-person for your teams when it comes to data related questions. 

  • Evaluate initiatives: Support product experimentation and impact measurement initiatives; design experiments and causal inference analyses, obtain cross-functional alignment, execute robust analyses, and deliver actionable insights. Share these learnings through clear documentation and concise, empathic communication.

  • Contribute to self-serve data platform: Help building the right analytics foundations ,by pairing up with technical peers, so our product teams can interact with data and extract the right insights themselves. 

  • Provide monitoring tools: Build the dashboards your team looks at every week to make sure they are impacting our company OKRs. 

  • Improve data literacy of organisation: Educate teams to become independent when it comes to data access and understanding function led training and team wide workshops to foster data driven culture.

  • Be part of our data-community: Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.

  • Support some of the following product & business team initiatives (not limited to): 

    • Support your team in discovery of new product ideas, identifying user friction points and business opportunities.

    • Evaluate your teams’ continuous releases making sure they are delivering on business goals via experimental or observational methods.

    • Collaborate with UX researchers to combine qualitative and quantitative research for better product hypotheses.

    • During product development you make sure all data needed for future evaluation is being captured through set up of tracking events or as part of the backend service.

    • Drive the quantitative analysis on your segment, being responsible for the insights and business discovery on the team.

What you need to be successful:

Background: 

  • 3+ years of experience, ideally within the Product or Analytics field. 

  • 1+ years of experience in the Investments or Wealth domain

Skills:

  • Strong understanding of statistical methods used in the analysis of experimental and observational data (e.g. causal inference)

  • Strong problem solving skills and is comfortable doing exploratory data analysis that generates insights and “so whats”

  • Highly experienced with SQL and Python/R for analytics

  • Experience working with one or more common data visualisation tools (Tableau, Metabase, Looker, Superset, etc)

  • Good presentation skills and communication skills.

  • Experience with Experimentation (e.g. AB testing, multivariate etc)

 

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most innovative banks 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.    
  • Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.  
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.

jobs.description:
About the opportunity

As our new Treasury Trader you will autonomously drive core treasury operations, liquidity and cash management, and investments (with a primary focus on public sector financing). Operating with high autonomy, you will manage the short term Treasury book, central bank operations, assess bank’s liquidity position and monitor key KPIs. Acting as a crucial bridge across Group Risk, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting, you will also as 1 LoD maintain audit readiness to ensure complete operational stability.

You will also enjoy our hybrid work model - flexibility of working both from home, and from our office in Barcelona. 

In this role, you will:

  • Trade Execution & Portfolio Management: Evaluate potential investment opportunities, then price (Bloomberg experience required), execute, and log transactions across Front Office tools, focusing primarily on public sector financing and short maturities. Proactively manage money market products and the short-term book, including Repo and Reverse Repo portfolios.
  • Liquidity & Reserve Management: Oversee key liquidity functions, including Bundesbank cash pooling, Eurosystem minimum reserve requirements, overnight deposits, credit lines, and short-term portfolio hedging.
  • Payment Systems & Central Bank Operations: Serve as the primary deputy for key payment and settlement infrastructure (Target, ESMIG, MACCS) and oversee central bank account management.
  • Audit, Compliance & Governance: Support internal and external audits, enforce compliance with key banking regulations, and drive First Line of Defense (1LoD) risk management.
  • Product & Tech Initiatives: Lead New Product Process (NPP) implementations, vendor onboarding, core banking system enhancements, and automated reporting solutions using SQL.

 

What you need to be successful:

  • Experience: Strong background in bank treasury operations, liquidity management, and money markets, with a preference for hands-on Repo/Reverse Repo and hedging experience.
  • Technical & System Expertise: Solid familiarity with Treasury Front Office tools (Bloomberg experience required), payment and settlement systems (Target, ESMIG, MACCS), and data querying skills (SQL).
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of financial markets combined with a sound grasp of Eurosystem frameworks, reserve requirements, and key European banking regulations (including MaRisk, CRR III, and KWG).
  • Ownership: Proven ability to drive cross-functional projects, step in as a trusted deputy across core functions, and operate autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

 

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.    
  • Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.  
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. 
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. 

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

Discover more about Diversity & Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

jobs.description: Abteilungsleiter (m/w/d) Vertriebsaußendienst Abteilungsleiter (m/w/d) Vertriebsaußendienst Berlin, Hamburg Berlin, Hamburg Abteilungsleiter (m/w/d) Vertriebsaußendienst Jetzt bewerben Als zentraler Dienstleister für Sparkassen stehen wir für Qualität, Innovation und Verlässlichkeit. Mit rund 1.400 Mitarbeitenden in ganz Deutschland sorgen wir täglich dafür, dass Prozesse und digitale Lösungen in der Marktfolge effizient laufen. So können sich Sparkassen auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren: ihre Kundinnen und Kunden. Wir befinden uns im Neuaufbau einer schlagkräftigen Vertriebsorganisation und als Abteilungsleiter (m/w/d) Vertriebsaußendienst gestalten Sie Strukturen von Beginn an mit. Dafür suchen wir eine unternehmerisch geprägte Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die den Markt bundesweit eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und den S-Servicepartner Deutschland als strategischen Partner der Sparkassen nachhaltig positioniert. Wir freuen uns mit Ihnen gemeinsam Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen! Ihre neuen Aufgaben Sie führen das Vertriebsaußendienst-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch und entwickeln es weiter Dabei haben Sie die Budget- und Ergebnisverantwortung Sie sichern das jährlich neu zu akquirierende Geschäft – vom absehbaren Folgebedarf des Kunden aus Sie führen den gesamten Kundenprozess: von Zugang und Bedarf über Angebot und Abschluss bis zu Wiederbeauftragung und Weiterentwicklung Zudem bauen Sie Zugänge zu Vorständen und Entscheidern auf und führen auch komplexe Entscheidungen verbindlich zum Abschluss Sie steuern den End-to-End-Vertriebsprozess über Fachbereiche, Innendienst und Servicefunktionen – lateral über klare Ziele, Verantwortlichkeiten und Entscheidungsrechte Für diesen Auftrag erhalten Sie ein klares Mandat zur Steuerung der umsatzrelevanten Kundenprozesse über die beteiligten Einheiten hinweg – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Bereichsleitung und Fachbereichen Ihren Bereich führen Sie mit Zahlen: Pipeline, Forecast, Abschluss- und Wiederbeauftragungsquote Ihre Stärken zählen Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung mit disziplinarischer Verantwortung: Sie haben Vertriebsteams aufgebaut oder neu ausgerichtet Messbare Erfolge im B2B-Lösungsvertrieb komplexer Dienstleistungen – von Zugang und Lösung bis Abschluss und Kundenentwicklung Wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse der Sparkassenfinanzgruppe Erfahrung mit Geschäft, das regelmäßig neu gewonnen oder verlängert werden muss Diplomatisches Geschick, Verhandlungsstärke und klare Abschlussorientierung Fähigkeit, einen komplexen B2B-Markt zu durchdringen, tragfähige Beziehungen aufzubauen und zum Abschluss zu führen Hohe Reisebereitschaft Unsere Benefits Gehalt: Wir zahlen fair und transparent dank unserer starken Betriebsvereinbarung. Die Vergütung dieser Position richtet sich nach Ihren Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen. Work-Life-Balance: Mit einer Rahmenarbeitszeit von 6 – 20 Uhr ohne Kernzeiten und individuellen Regelungen zum mobilen Arbeiten bieten wir Ihnen die Flexibilität, die Sie brauchen. Mobilität: Unkomplizierte Arbeitswege – mit unserem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, attraktivem Fahrradleasing und allseits bequemer Anbindung. Perspektive: Ein anspruchsvolles und abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit Gestaltungsspielraum – wir wachsen gemeinsam. Gesundheit: Mit unserem betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement sorgen wir aktiv für Ihr Wohlbefinden. Und das fängt bereits bei höhenverstellbaren Tischen an. Gemeinschaft: Unser Erfolg beruht auf starken Teams, die verlässlich und vertrauensvoll zusammenarbeiten. Unser kollegiales Miteinander zeigt sich im Workshop ebenso wie auf dem Betriebsfest. Unsere Benefits sind so vielfältig wie Ihre Karrierewege bei uns. HIER finden Sie alle Angebote. Lust bekommen? Dann direkt über unser kurzes Online-Formular bewerben! Doch noch offene Fragen? jobs.title: (Junior) Account Manager (all genders)
jobs.description: In ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck. Kraftstoffkosten steigen, regulatorische Anforderungen werden komplexer und der Umstieg auf emissionsärmere Fahrzeuge nimmt Fahrt auf. Gleichzeitig verwalten noch immer rund 70 % der europäischen Unternehmen ihre Flotten mit Excel-Tabellen, isolierten Tools und Prozessen, die für die heutigen Herausforderungen nie ausgelegt waren. Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt. Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort. Über die Rolle Als Junior Account Manager:in übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Shiftmove bei. Dein Ziel ist es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nicht nur langfristig zu sichern, sondern ihr Potenzial gezielt auszuschöpfen – durch Renewals, Upselling, Cross-Selling und die Entwicklung neuer Umsatzmöglichkeiten. Dabei betreust du ein umfangreiches Portfolio an B2B-Kunden mit einem Geschäftsvolumen von rund 4–5 Mio. €. Du erkennst kommerzielle Chancen, gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen und bringst Opportunities erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success Team zusammen, übernimmst aber die eigenständige Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Entwicklung deiner Accounts. Das erwartet dich Account Management: Du betreust ein Portfolio von ca. 300–400 SMB-Bestandskunden. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert, priorisierst effektiv und stellst sicher, dass deine Pipeline jederzeit aktuell ist. Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen, koordinierst Termine und erkennst durch systematisches Screening Potenziale innerhalb deiner Accounts. Renewal: Du verantwortest die Verlängerung von Kundenverträgen, erstellst Angebote, führst Preisverhandlungen und dokumentierst alle relevanten Informationen sauber in Salesforce und Planhat. Expansion: Gemeinsam mit Customer Success identifizierst du Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kund und kannst nachvollziehbar vermitteln, welchen Mehrwert zusätzliche Produkte oder Lösungen für sie schaffen. Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner auf Kundenseite und lernst, auch komplexere Entscheidungsprozesse strukturiert zu steuern. Pipeline & Forecasting: Du dokumentierst relevante Entwicklungen in Salesforce und Planhat, hältst deine Opportunities aktuell und erstellst realistische Forecasts für deine Pipeline Was du mitbringst Erste Berufserfahrung: Du hast erste Erfahrungen im Account Management, Customer Success oder B2B-Vertrieb gesammelt Lernbereitschaft & Coachability: Du bist offen für Feedback, möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus. Kundenorientierung : Du hast Freude am Kundenkontakt und am Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen Organisation : Du behältst auch bei mehreren Kunden und Aufgaben den Überblick Kommunikation : Du kommunizierst klar, überzeugend und auf Augenhöhe mit Kunden Branchenkenntnisse : Erfahrung mit SaaS, Fleet Management oder Automotive ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss Sprachen : Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch mind. B2 Warum uns? Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa und machen komplexe Flottenprozesse einfacher, effizienter und datengetriebener. Etwas Sinnvolles skalieren: Als profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen verbinden wir Stabilität mit Geschwindigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum.
